statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The arrhythmia remains poorly characterized despite prior evaluation
Extended monitoring is necessary to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
